prompt: Prepare the Atlas cutover record for 2026-11-06. Save /workspace/deliverable.json with allocation_revision, replica_count, window_utc, readiness_reference, mandate_reference and rollback_minutes. Post a short handover summary and its path in #engineering.

documents.deployment.md: Atlas is a Database service. Draft A-6 plans 4 replicas, window 01:00-01:30 UTC, rollback 10 minutes, readiness QA-OLD-6 and mandate TECH-DRAFT-6. Target date 2026-11-06.
documents.operations-policy.md: Current Database allocation revisions are maintained by its project coordination function. Readiness binds allocation revision, replica count, window and rollback interval. Production windows that overlap a regional freeze require an executive technical mandate after readiness; other windows are within the project lead mandate.
documents.calendar.md: Regional freeze on 2026-11-06: 02:00-04:00 UTC. All times UTC. The recovery team requires rollback interval of 20 minutes for six or more replicas; otherwise 10 minutes. Leadership calendar: CTO travelling 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-09 without sign-off access; designated technical deputy for the period is listed in the Engineering out-of-office note.
documents.ownership.md: Operational quality attestations belong to cross-team QA. Executive technical mandates belong to the CTO; while the CTO is away, the designated technical deputy issues them with the same authority. Each mandate must cite the readiness record and the applicable freeze interval.
documents.engineering-ooo.md: Engineering out-of-office, week of 2026-11-02: Sarah Johnson (CTO) away; designated technical deputy: Zhang Wei. Emily Zhou away 2026-11-05.
